text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new year has arrived. Shinko Windy is 
finally moving up to the Classic Year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was still New Year's break, but wanting 
to lightly check over the work awaiting me 
after the holidays, I headed to the 
Trainer's room, when...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gyah! Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That was faster than I thought... Well, 
fine... Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Umm, well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan just got here this very 
second! C-Complete coincidence!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I should pretend not to notice. ...Just as 
I thought that, I realized.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the room, there turned out to be 
three unfamiliar objects placed there...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aaah~~!! There's something lying right 
over heeere!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This is...! A "Treasure Map"! It says 
there's treasure just a quick run away!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"There's a tiered food box on the desk 
too!! It must be full of delicious 
osechi~!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And and! Over there is a money envelope 
too, nod! It says "1 million yen" on it, 
nod!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Surely, this is a gift from someone for 
you. You should accept it with gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It's surely all a trap. Shinko Windy 
watched our reaction with expectant eyes.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Come on, minion! Which one should we do 
first?
choice_data_list_en: (Guess I'll play along and take the bait...!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see~! Then let's get going right 
away!
choice_data_list: 『宝の地図』が示す場所へ走る！
choice_data_list_en: Run to the spot marked on the treasure map!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hurry, hurry! It's near that tree!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way to where she was pointing, 
there was a patch where the ground was 
clearly a different color. ...All right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle rustle! Wheeeew—thump!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nnnrgh!! Gyaaa ha ha ha ha! It's a pitfall 
traaaaap!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The pit was packed with tons of cushions. 
On top of that, it was deep enough to 
rival any variety show prank. They put way 
more effort into this than expected...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
How's that, huh?! Windy-chan's super 
authentic, special-grade pitfall trap!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You won't be able to crawl back up on your 
own anymore! Heh-heh-heh-heh~! Beg for 
Windy-chan's help!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Digging a hole this deep must have been 
tough. It surely trained her legs and hips 
well. Thinking that brought a smile to my 
face."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Dwahahaha! Dwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Not good enough yet, noda—! I'm gonna drop 
tons of fallen leaves from above, noda—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Eventually, looking thoroughly 
satisfied, she lowered a rope ladder to 
rescue me. I'm just glad she had fun...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Osechi, huh? Sounds great. Let's open it 
up right away, then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the lid of the first layer... 
something leaped out from inside with 
incredible force!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hyahaha! It was a jack-in-the-box all 
along, huh~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer... Getting so scared of a toy 
snake... Pffft, haha!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Still, maybe the second tier has the truly 
delicious stuff in it~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Could the second layer also be a 
jack-in-the-box...? Staying on guard, I 
slowly and carefully open it up...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside was a truly delicious-looking 
osechi set. Black soybeans, herring roe, 
fish cakes, sweet rolled omelets, and 
more... all glossy and festive.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! What magnificent osechi it is♪ Come 
on, Trainer, aren't you going to eat?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is there mustard inside...? Bracing 
myself, I dip the fish cake in soy sauce 
and bring it to my mouth...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Aah-hah-hah-hah-hah~~~~! 
Hee-hee-hee-hee-hee!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What looked like a fish cake... turned 
out to be a gummy!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking closely at the other dishes, their 
surfaces were made of marzipan and jelly. 
When I dug in with my chopsticks, the 
inside was filled with sponge cake and 
cream...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's sweets made to look just like real 
osechi!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ain't I amazing~~! Windy-chan found it 
online and bought it right away!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
They had all kinds of other stuff too, 
like ramen, gyoza, tonkatsu, and even 
sushi~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Look at my minion, pouring soy sauce all 
over their snacks...! Hehehe...! Bwahaha!
choice_data_list: Anyone could be fooled by this...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, that was fun, nod. Now then, now that 
the secret's out...
choice_data_list_en: Anyone would get fooled by this...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy-chan wants some too! Trainer! Bring 
me some juice!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
*munch munch*... It's delicious! It looks 
crazy, but it's just a normal cake!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oho~ One million yen~~! I mean, who 
doesn't want money~~? Nishishi!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Turning a blind eye to the fact that a 
million yen couldn't possibly fit in such 
a tiny envelope, I pick it up and open it, 
and...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gyaa-hahahaha!!! What a crazy face you're 
making~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From inside the envelope came... the 
overwhelming stench of chameleon plant! 
Inside was a piece of absorbent cotton 
soaked in dark green liquid.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh-heh! It's chameleon plant 
weeds that grew in the academy's fields, 
that's what!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I chopped up a bunch, tore it to shreds, 
ground it all down, and made a super 
stinky mush!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Ghehehehe~~! What an intense smell, 
right?! Totally blew away that New Year's 
mood, didn't it~~!"
choice_data_list_en: (A lot of care went into this...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised... or rather, it really 
shook me out of my post-New Year daze. 
Dokudami is also used in herbal medicine, 
so it should be good for the body...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides, weeding the fields on your own 
initiative is...
choice_data_list:
Good on you for working hard right at New 
Year's!

Good on you for working hard right at New 
Year's!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
choice_data_list_en: Working hard right from New Year's, impressive!
Working hard right from New Year's, impressive!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
W-Why are you praising me?! I just pulled 
a prank on you, so why...?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ugaaaah!! That really ticks me off!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: *CHOMP---!*

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gyahahahaha! I knew biting was the best 
prank ever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, with her in high spirits after 
pulling off her prank, we exchanged New 
Year's greetings once again.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "Yeah! Happy New Year-noda."
choice_data_list: あけましておめでとう

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Still, your 'first blunder' of the 
year... Kukuku, it was a total 
masterpiece!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That was a great start, nodda! Windy-chan 
is gonna pull tons of pranks again this 
year, nodda!
choice_data_list: Let's do our best in the race too.
Let's do our best in the race too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Geez, be quiet, that's totally obvious!
choice_data_list_en: Let's do our best in the race too, alright?
Let's do our best in the race too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy-chan did pretty well last year too, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be flexin' even more this year! 
You'd better brace yourself so you can 
keep up with me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the fan count is steadily 
growing too, so let's keep this up and 
grab the spotlight!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, looking forward to working with you 
this year too!

Yeah, looking forward to working with you 
this year too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lately, her footing has become solid, and 
worries about "shin splints" have faded.
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, looking forward to working with you this year too!
Yeah, looking forward to working with you this year too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It would soon be fine to step up the 
intensity of her training with a tough 
race in mind. New Year's passed, carrying 
with it a bright sense of anticipation.
